hypothesis: Constrained return model repairs short-lookback return and drawdown, but loses return at long-lookback/low-target settings. Raw specialists retain broad return signal but worsen12M drawdown. Test explicit short-lookback routing and equal-weight percentile ensembles of these complementary predictions, without additional fitted thresholds.
routing: short_monotone_v15 uses monotone_utility at lookback<=12 and frozen V15 at longer lookbacks. Both blend kinds average correction prediction percentiles50/50 then use common alpha and original evidence confidence.
selection: Highest strong-eligible development utility, then lowest negative-return date fraction, then lower alpha. If none pass, continue a separately locked development research round.
unchanged_gates: Original V15 gates plus all-profile return >=0, all-profile drawdown >=-0.01, 12M return/drawdown >=0, weekly return>=0. Select on development utility and lower adverse-date concentration; no exposed/current selection. Failures trigger a documented new development-only research round, not threshold changes.
next_checks: Selected architecture will be checked with per-date refresh and independent random seeds; these are robustness checks, not blind tests.
